name: search
description: Search the learner's files (the data folder, as str_replace_based_edit_tool sees it) for a text: each match as path:line: the line. Literal and case-insensitive; regex: true for a regular expression. path: a directory or a file to search in (the whole folder by default). Private files are left out.

pattern.description: The text (or with regex: true, the regular expression) to find.

path.description: A directory or file in the data folder (default: all of it).
